description: Request side: the only input besides the raw body. In `serve` mode it is the request's `Content-Type` header.

content_type.description: `application/x-norito` (versioned Norito SignedTransaction, what the CLI sends) or `application/json` (optionally `; charset=utf-8`). Same rule as Torii's `typed_request_content_format`.

title: DecodeTxReq
